messages:
jana: Quick chase on overdue PM items from RED-2154 1026. A couple of remediation tickets still show no activity. Can owners confirm or reassign today?

lee: I'm listed for RED-7602 (circuit-breaker + graceful failover). I had a WIP but got pulled onto a pager storm. Will re-prioritize, can complete a small PR today.

omar: I own RED-7611 (dashboard + alerting thresholds). I planned to finish last week but hit a data permissions issue with metrics. Filed INC-5692 to unblock.

sre-bot: Reminder: RED-7602 due 2026-04-10, assigned to lee. RED-7611 due 2026-04-09, assigned to omar.

jana: If we can't get both wrapped by EOD tomorrow, please set ticket to "Needs Reassign" and ping me. This PM is flagged as a recurring pattern in the notes; we need closure.

lee: Working on a minimal CB that we can roll without downtime. Draft PR: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/9024. Still need a runbook link and commit hash in the ticket. ETA: EOD.

omar: INC-5692 approved by cloud team this morning. I can now pull the metrics snapshot and finish the dashboard. I'll update RED-7611 with commit and link once merged.

sre-bot: Auto-check: INC-5692 status changed to Approved by cloud-team-bot.

ops-bot: FYI quota adjust INC-5692 applied to prod-metrics-read with change id 2026-04-02T09:15Z.

lee: PR merged: commit d1e4b7a. Updated RED-7602 with commit and added runbook section at https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/circuit-breaker. Set ticket to "Ready for Verify".

omar: Dashboard PR merged: commit b7c3f22. Updated RED-7611 with commit and linked alert thresholds. Added verification step: "no 5xx for 72h at 95th percentile traffic."

jana: Great. Two final asks before I close the cluster: 1) owners paste deployment time windows into the tickets; 2) SRE please run the verification check and confirm 72h status.

sre-bot: Scheduling automated verification: will check error rates for 72h window and post results.

jana: Also, can someone add a short note in the PM tracker about the recurring detection gap and the proposed fix (automated synthetic at 80% pool use)? If we open a follow-up ticket, link it.

omar: Filed RED-7688 for early-warning synthetic. Linked to PM.

lee: Deployment window recorded in RED-7602: 2026-04-03 11:30 UTC. No rollback needed for the CB feature (stateless config).

sre-bot: Verification result: no connection errors detected in 72h window. Marking RED-2154 follow-ups as VERIFIED.

jana: Awesome 1 Thanks everyone. I'll mark the postmortem follow-up cluster closed and note the recurring pattern mitigation. Reopen if anything pops. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Action: Postmortem follow-ups for RED-2154 marked CLOSED by jana.

lee: Thanks all. Learned a bunch about small-surface deploys for CB.

omar: Closing my side. Will monitor the synthetic once it's live.

jana: Thread closed.
